items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Alfred Williams today When you hear him the only thing he does Is get louder

ctx.x: Not like that That's why I like Katz Maistre You see Katz is a drummer? And he sets a tempo and that's it You can't accuse him of picking up time If time was picked up in a band One of the other instruments done it Katz didn't do it He is really on the ball, man Played a nice set of drums
Alfred Williams today When you hear him the only thing he does Is get louder Yeah But he never changes anything, you know He keeps that same beat going

That's the fault of most of the drummers that did, Dick They pick up the tempo, they drop the tempo They pick it up again And that's a tough man to play with You know that, Paul If a man keeps picking up the tempo And dropping it, it's rough man That's one...that's why I like Sharky's way of playing Sharky will set a tempo and that's it, man He'll lead And if he plays that piece 50 times He'll play it in the same tempo 50 times You play it with Sharky enough to know that Most guys, they play a piece one time in…
